For a banking customer in Brussels, we are searching for a freelance SQL DBA for a senior mission.
Responsibilities

• Help define, implement and maintain highly available, performant & scalable database systems to effectively meet IT Business requirements

• Be involved in deployment and patching automation

• Maintain (backups, transaction log management, index optimisation etc) and upgrade the database systems etc

• Review database schema changes to ensure compliance with standards and ensure optimal choice of indexing, column definitions etc.

• Help with problem solving in case of performance problems or functional issues in applications

• Build a strong relationship both within the infrastructure team and with the development teams

• Promote best practices

• Maintain the deployment pipeline

Additional details

Seniority: Medior/Senior

Start Date: October/November

Duration: Long-term

Extension: Yes

Contract: Freelance

Location: Brussels

Onsite Policy: 50%

Hours Per Week: 40

Languages: Fluent English and French/Dutch

Interview Process: 1 stage

• Expert knowledge of SQL Server administration, performance tuning, high availability and disaster recovery

• Strong experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, Oracle and enterprise database operations

• Hands-on experience with AWS database services (Aurora, RDS for SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MySQL, DynamoDB)

• Experience with Azure database services (Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, CosmosDB)

• Strong troubleshooting skills across database, operating system and infrastructure layers

• Experience with PowerShell and infrastructure automation

• Good knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory and Red Hat Linux

 

Strongly preferred:

• Experience with TerraForm, Ansible or similar Infrastructure-as-Code tools

• Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Redgate , Dynatrace, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor or equivalent

• Experience modernising legacy database platforms

• Experience with GIT, Jira and CI/CD-driven deployment processes

• Experience with cloud security, encryption, backup and disaster recovery solutions

• Experience with performance monitoring and capacity management in cloud environments

• Knowledge of Power BI, SSAS or reporting platforms

 

Nice to have:

• VMware vSphere and ESXi administration knowledge

• CommVault or enterprise backup solutions

• Basic networking and load-balancing (F5) concepts

• Azure Entra ID and Azure platform services

• Basic knowledge of Go or Python programming language

Soft skills

• Good communication skills enabling you to explain complex technical issues is an easy-to-understand way

• Like to keep up to date with the latest technology trends

• Fluent English and good knowledge of either French or Dutch

• Advanced investigation & problem solving skills with strong analytical skills

• Availability & flexibility

• Interested in cloud technologies and what the future may bring

• Have a clean certificate of good behaviour

We are looking for a skilled Senior Accountant to join the Finance team in Leuven.

In this role, you will be a key pillar of our 6-member financial department, taking ownership of accounting tasks from A to Z.

To succeed, you must be experienced in Belgian and familiar with international accounting principles, highly analytical, and possess an high attention to detail. Your goal will be to drive the overall efficiency of our financial operations, ensure the accuracy and compliance of the day-to-day accounting and manage the month end closing process.

• Support the AP accountant with incoming invoices in accordance with Belgian accounting and VAT principles
• Manage the AP invoice approval cycle efficiently.
• Take ownership of the AP accounting for our subsidiaries (Germany, The Netherlands, UK, Finland, and Singapore). 
• Support bookings and meticulously reconcile bank statements.
• Register journal entries payroll bookings for Belgium and international entities.
• Manage fixed assets and book depreciations across all subsidiaries.
• Register prepaid expenses, accruals, and provisions.
• Prepare and file Belgian VAT returns, as well as VAT filings for foreign subsidiaries.
• Lead the monthly closing process for all corporate entities.
• Assist with group-level financial reconciliations, consolidation and reporting.
 

• Education: minimum Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Finance, Accountancy) or equivalent experience.
• Experience: Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience with Belgian accounting rules and VAT.
• Languages: Excellent command of English (spoken and written) alongside a good working knowledge of Dutch.
• Skills: Strong analytical acumen, great comfort with numbers, and an uncompromising attention to detail.
• Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of Belgian accounting and financial reporting practices. Advanced knowledge of MS Office is required.
• Pluses: Previous experience with NetSuite and/or Salesforce is considered a strong asset.

About the Role
Are you a hands-on technical professional who enjoys troubleshooting industrial equipment as much as carrying out practical maintenance and repair work?

For an industrial production site in Louvain-la-Neuve, we are looking for an Electromechanic & Technical Handyman to join the team.

This is a varied role combining 50% industrial electromechanical maintenance and 50% general technical maintenance. You will play an important role in ensuring the reliability of the production line while keeping the company's facilities and infrastructure in good condition.

Your Responsibilities
50% – Electromechanical Maintenance
Monitor the production line and identify technical faults or malfunctions.
Diagnose electrical and mechanical problems and determine their root causes.
Carry out repairs and implement effective technical solutions to minimize production downtime.
Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on production equipment.
Check the proper functioning of machines and production installations.
Inspect electrical wiring and cabling and carry out troubleshooting when necessary.
Identify potential technical improvements to increase equipment reliability and performance.
Follow all applicable safety, quality and hygiene procedures.
50% – Technical Handyman & Facility Maintenance
Carry out general maintenance and repair work throughout the company.
Perform painting, minor renovation and finishing work.
Repair and maintain gates, doors and other company infrastructure.
Handle minor electrical, mechanical and technical repairs within your area of competence.
Identify maintenance needs and take the necessary corrective actions.
Ensure that buildings, facilities and work areas remain safe, functional and well maintained.
Support the team with various practical maintenance tasks as required.

We are looking for a versatile, hands-on professional with a strong technical background and a proactive approach.

You ideally have:

Previous experience in industrial maintenance.
Good knowledge of industrial electricity and mechanics.
Strong knowledge of electrical wiring and cabling.
The ability to diagnose faults, identify their causes and find practical solutions.
Knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics or automation is an advantage.
Experience in the food, pharmaceutical or chemical industry is a strong asset.
Practical skills in general maintenance, repairs and basic building work.
A good understanding of safety procedures and technical instructions.
A structured, methodical and independent approach to your work.
A strong sense of responsibility, flexibility and problem-solving skills.

 

Languages
English: Very good proficiency.
French: Very good proficiency.
You must be comfortable communicating in both languages in a professional working environment.

Working Hours
Monday to Friday.
Flexible working schedule between 06:00 and 22:00, depending on the company's operational needs.
Availability to work within this time window is required.
